 Brock Purdy, 49ers excited for Demarcus Robinson's return from ankle injury 
 San Francisco 49ers quarterback Brock Purdy and OC Klay Kubiak are looking forward to having receiver Demarcus Robinson back in the mix this weekend. 
 By Jennifer Lee Chan • 
 Published November 5, 2026 • 
 Updated on November 5, 2026 at 6:29 pm 
 BOOKMARKER 
 Share 
 NBC Universal, Inc. 
 Raheem Morris, Klay Kubiak, George Kittle and more speak to reporters following the San Francisco 49ers’ practice on Thursday in Santa Clara. 
 SANTA CLARA — The 49ers look to be getting one of their Week 1 starters back on the field on Sunday as the team hosts the Las Vegas Raiders at Levi's Stadium. 
 Demarcus Robinson practiced for the second consecutive session on Thursday, and both Brock Purdy and offensive coordinator Klay Kubiak are looking forward to getting the wideout back in the mix. 
 “It’s been good getting him back out there,” Purdy said. “Obviously, he’s a savvy route runner, and so I love that. To have him go out there and be able to create some good separation and his length, being able to throw and have him be able to go up and get it, even if it’s not a perfect ball. So, having him out there, you can feel him.”

 Robinson was an active part of the offensive scheme until he suffered a high ankle sprain in the 49ers' Week 2 win over the Miami Dolphins. The Florida product has five catches on the season for 84 yards and a touchdown over those two contests. 
 “He’s so good to have back out there,” Kubiak said. “He’s working his butt off, practicing good. Been out for a while, so you’ve got to get back up to playing full-speed football again. Running routes, getting timing with the quarterback, but he jumped right back in there like he hasn’t missed a beat, so excited to have him back.”
 The 49ers will need production from Robinson with both Mike Evans and Deebo Samuel each likely missing another game. Evans is rehabbing from Achilles tendonitis that kept him out of San Francisco's Week 7 loss to the Atlanta Falcons, while Samuel still is rehabbing from a hamstring injury that occurred in its Week 5 win over the Seattle Seahawks. 
 “Obviously, I thought we were in a great rhythm before he got hurt,” Purdy said of Robinson. “I was really excited for what we were going to do this year. And obviously we got hindered with his injury, but excited to have him back and hopefully pick up where we left off.”
